observations: Torah #187 has zero bechina edges in torahData.js and therefore no algorithmically derived packages can be formed. The framework requires actual bechina edges from the dataset as the structural basis for packages — source text alone is insufficient. That said, the source text contains a coherent conceptual cluster that, once encoded as bechina edges, would naturally form one primary package and possibly a second smaller one. The primary cluster centers on the identity between chesed and mida-k'neged-mida, with ארץ ישראל as the spatial locus where this identity is most fully expressed: חסד ↔ מדה כנגד מדה ↔ ארץ אוכלת יושביה ↔ ארץ ישראל ↔ גילוי עוון. All five concepts share the same essential nature in this teaching — they are all expressions of the same divine precision-lovingkindness that mirrors a person's deeds back to them. This cluster would form a good-polarity package (since chesed and mida-k'neged-mida are here framed as divine mercy enabling teshuva, not as punishment). A second smaller cluster — יסורין (suffering) ↔ מהירות הדין (speed of judgment in Eretz Israel) — is also present but at only two nodes it would likely be proposed as a merge into the primary package rather than a standalone package. No evil-polarity mirror is present in this text: the teaching frames measure-for-measure exclusively as a positive mechanism of chesed and teshuva, with no opposing dark-side counterpart discussed. If reference-187 edges are ever added to torahData.js, a single good-polarity package centered on 'חֶסֶד וּמִדָּה כְּנֶגֶד מִדָּה בְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל — Lovingkindness and Measure-for-Measure in the Land of Israel' should be the primary package candidate.
